params.name: Input
params.description: The page node (or page chain) whose image this grid is drawn onto. Without one the node produces nothing.

params.name: Cell Size
params.description: Spacing between grid lines, in the page's Units. Lines start at the top-left corner; smaller values give a denser grid, never finer than one pixel.

params.name: Line Width
params.description: Thickness of each grid line, in the page's Units, centred on its coordinate. Very small values are drawn as a hairline at least half a pixel wide.

params.name: Line Color
params.description: Colour of the grid lines, drawn fully opaque over the page.

params.name: Fill Cells
params.description: When on, fills the whole page with Cell Color before ruling the lines, covering what the input had drawn. When off, lines are drawn over the input as is.

params.name: Cell Color
params.description: Colour the page is filled with under the grid lines when Fill Cells is on.
